steps.message: What does the auth mock warning in the test output mean?
It fires when a test skips logout, so the mock session outlives the test. It is harmless: every suite resets the mock in `beforeEach`.
Fix the flaky login test so it stops timing out in CI
Let me look at the test first.

The test raced the redirect. It now waits for the session response instead of sleeping 2 s:

```ts
await page.waitForResponse(
  (r) => r.url().endsWith('/session'),
)
expect(await cookie()).toBeTruthy()
```

Ran the suite 20 times locally with no failures. One unrelated warning remains in the auth mock.
Run the full e2e suite and summarise the failures
